name: higgsfield
one_liner: Self-serve API and MCP server for generating image and video with 50+ AI models.
auth_notes: Server-side Authorization: Key KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET header; key shown once at creation. MCP connects through a Higgsfield account sign-in with no API key.
access_notes: Self-serve, no subscription: create an account, add a payment method, top up a USD balance (minimum $5), then create a key. Not a free tier; the enum has no pay-as-you-go value.

buildability.rationale: Documented REST API with Python and TypeScript SDKs and key auth, but requires a payment method and funded USD balance before keys spend. Generation is async; output files are kept only 7 days.

identity.quote: Higgsfield provides one integration point for generative media models.

auth.quote: authenticate server-side with Authorization: Key YOUR_KEY_ID:YOUR_KEY_SECRET.
Do not use a Bearer token or expose the secret in browser or mobile code.

access.quote: Add a payment method and top up your balance.
Billing is pay-as-you-go from a US dollar balance, and the minimum top-up is $5.

api_surface.quote: Connect through the Python or TypeScript SDK, or call the REST API directly from any language with an HTTP client
track progress by polling the status or by receiving a webhook when the result is ready.

mcp.quote: Higgsfield uses MCP (Model Context Protocol), an open standard that gives AI agents access to external tools.
No. Add the Higgsfield MCP server URL in your agent's settings and authenticate through your Higgsfield account.

buildability.quote: Generated output files stay available for at least 7 days after creation
